newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR FINISHES WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR FINISHES WEDNESDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Wednesday weaker against the U.S. dollar and the rand but posted gains against European currencies, forex dealers said.
"There were no really big payments today. We just saw one or two banks buying in the market," one dealer said.

He added that another possible reason for the local currency's drop against the key U.S. dollar could be that people were holding onto their cash for a rumoured big payment tender scheduled for Thursday.
At the close of Wednesday's interbank session among commercial and merchant banks, the Zimbabwe dollar was trading at 11.1625/1725 against the U.S. unit, down from Tuesday's 11.1475/1575.
On the crosses, it was quoted firmer against sterling at 17.7540/7790 compared to 17.8700/8900 and at 6.5415/5490 from 6.5600/5700 versus the mark.
Against the South African rand however it slipped to 2.5230/5270 from 2.5200/5300 the previous day.
